join_completeness.definition: For plays where a tracklet is visible AND a jersey is readable, the fraction that join to a roster player_id AND then to an nflverse participation row, on the same game_id + play_id.
join_completeness.denominator_rule: Plays with no readable jersey are EXCLUDED (honestly skipped), not failed.

join_accuracy.definition: On a manually labeled sample of >=200 player-plays, joined player_id matches true roster identity.
join_accuracy.ground_truth: manual label sample; cross-checkable against depth_charts gsis_id

temporal_alignment.definition: The join keys must match the nflverse play within +/-1 play index. Systematic off-by-one FAILS.
temporal_alignment.test: for each joined row, re-resolve the play in PBP; a join whose (game_id, play_id) has no PBP twin is misaligned

no_silent_imputation.definition: OCR below declared confidence threshold, or multiple roster players sharing a jersey in that game, returns NULL + logs the reason. Any guessing path fails.
no_silent_imputation.implementation: identity_join.py refuses on column-length mismatch; join_nflverse_when_identity returns null+reason on missing jersey; both paths log

downstream_calibration_check.threshold: post-join film features must IMPROVE or be NEUTRAL to held-out log-score; degradation FAILS even if the join is accurate
downstream_calibration_check.measurement: reliability/log-score comparison on a held-out week, with vs without recomputed player-level features (route mix, avg separation)

freshness_bound.threshold: joined row available to the decision layer before the relevant market moves more than the declared threshold
freshness_bound.measurement: join timestamp vs market-move timestamp (kalshi_full_slate captures at N-minute cadence)
freshness_bound.late_rule: late joins are marked STALE and do not count toward join_completeness

not_required: every tracklet identified - anonymous tracklets keep team-level features or are dropped
film features at nonzero weight in the final model - the spec only PERMITS consideration
real-time performance on first pass - batch validation on historical film flips the flag; latency is a separate freshness gate
